The *Mātikā* (Mil 7.1) constitutes the opening matrix or table of contents for the seventh section of the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, it is titled *Matrix* in English by Bhikkhu Sujato and is cataloged with three translations in three languages [SuttaCentral].

Automated analysis by DharmaNexus reflects the text's function as a structural matrix within the collection: it shares 164 matching passages across 17 other Pali texts, all of which are subsequent question sections in chapter 7 of the *Milindapañha* [DharmaNexus]. Its primary reuse partners include the *Agadaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.8.5), *Vagguliṅgapañha* (Mil 7.6.7), *Biḷāraṅgapañha* (Mil 7.5.2), *Tacchakaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.7.10), and *Makkaṭaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.2.10), representing the expansion of the items set out in the initial *mātikā* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of the text with several Tibetan treatises, such as the *Abhidhānaśāstraviśvalocana* / *Muktāvalī* (D4453) and the *Mahāmayūrīvidyārājñīsūtra-śatasahasraṭīkā* (D2691); however, these represent low-scoring machine alignments (plausibility scores between 15 and 30) rather than curated parallels [DharmaNexus].
